audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Does the request-response client enforce count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS response limit?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: totalCount = request.Count * len(request.Columns) is bounded by maxRequestDataColumnSidecars (16384) before the read loop. numberOfColumns (128) is fetched but used only for logging, not enforcement. The loop reads at most totalCount items.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample found. The enforcement limit is count * columnsCount (actual requested columns), which is always <= count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS. The client never accepts more sidecars than it requested.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: The check is on the client (consumer) side. A malicious server can inject fewer items (early EOF) or more items (caught by post-loop EOF check at line 559).

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Invariant proven: loop bound is totalCount (pre-computed at line 474-477), post-loop EOF assertion ensures no additional items escape. Actual limit enforced (count * len(columns)) is tighter than or equal to count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: for range totalCount loop (line 516) + post-loop EOF assertion (line 559) in SendDataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest

audit_items.rationale: The client correctly enforces count * len(request.Columns) as the response limit, which equals count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS when all columns are requested and is stricter otherwise. The post-loop EOF check at rpc_send_request.go:559 ensures no over-service is accepted. Property is satisfied.

audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Does the beacon-node server limit DataColumnSidecarsByRange responses to count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Server quota is initialized to MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars (16384) at line 41, NOT to min(request.Count * len(wantedColumns), MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars). The per-request count * columns limit mandated by the Ethereum Fulu networking spec is never computed or applied on the server side.
state_anomalies_found: quota initialized to MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars (16384) regardless of request.Count * len(wantedColumns)
server may stream up to 16384 sidecars even for a count=1, columns=[x] request (quota=16384 vs spec-required quota=1)

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Counterexample found at the spec compliance level: the server quota is never min(count * len(columns), MAX). Practical over-serve is naturally bounded by database contents, but in edge cases (slot-clipping in validateDataColumnsByRange expanding effective range), the server can serve more sidecars than count * len(wantedColumns) allows.
phase2_symbolic_execution.counterexample: Request with Count=1, columns=[0]: spec allows max 1 sidecar; server quota is 16384. If slot clipping via validateDataColumnsByRange causes more canonical blocks in the adjusted range than count implies, the server would over-serve beyond the spec limit.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: dataColumnSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler is registered as a libp2p stream handler on RPCDataColumnSidecarsByRangeTopicV1 and is directly reachable by any connected peer.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: The invariant 'sidecars_served <= request.Count * len(request.Columns)' is not enforced by the server. Only the global MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars cap is applied. The client-side code (rpc_send_request.go:472-477) correctly validates count*columns <= MAX but the server side has no equivalent check.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: Only guard present: quota <= MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars (16384). MISSING: quota <= min(request.Count * len(wantedColumns), MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars)

audit_items.rationale: Spec compliance violation: Ethereum Fulu networking spec mandates server responses MUST NOT exceed min(count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS, MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS). The server initializes quota to MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars at rpc_data_column_sidecars_by_range.go:41 without applying the per-request count * columns cap. Practical impact is limited by database contents but the missing limit is a confirmed deviation from the specification.
audit_items.recommendation: Initialize server quota as: quota := min(request.Count * uint64(len(wantedColumns)), beaconConfig.MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars). This mirrors the client-side validation already present in SendDataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest (rpc_send_request.go:472-477).

audit_items.title: Falsification Test: Can a response exceed count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars for a small count value?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: For count=1, columnsCount=3: totalCount=3. For count=1, columnsCount=128: totalCount=128. Loop bound is set before reading; no overflow possible (pre-checked against maxRequestDataColumnSidecars=16384).

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Falsification attempt failed. For any (count, columns) pair, totalCount = count * len(columns) is fixed before the read loop. A peer sending more items than totalCount is caught by the post-loop EOF check at line 559.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Even under adversarial server conditions, client reads exactly totalCount items then verifies EOF. Excess items trigger errMaxResponseDataColumnSidecarsExceeded and nil return.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Post-condition holds: result length always <= totalCount = count * len(request.Columns). For count=1, at most len(request.Columns) sidecars accepted, satisfying the stricter-or-equal bound vs NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: for range totalCount loop (line 516) + EOF assertion (line 559)

audit_items.rationale: Client-side post-condition is enforced: a response cannot exceed count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars because loop limit is count * len(columns) where len(columns) <= NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS. Falsification attempt yields no violation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Is the data column sidecar inclusion proof correctly verified via verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: VerifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof validates nil-header, root length, reconstructs KZG commitments merkle subtree from sidecar.KzgCommitments, and checks Merkle proof against block body root. All guard conditions are present before cryptographic work. SidecarInclusionProven wrapper has LRU cache keyed on inclusion proof bytes + signed block header HTR.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Gossip path at validate_data_column.go:143 calls verifier.SidecarInclusionProven() and returns REJECT on error. VerifiedRODataColumns() barrier at line 168 enforces requirement is satisfied before propagation.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: RequireSidecarInclusionProven is in GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements; check is mandatory and enforced before acceptance. Own-peer bypass is by-design libp2p behavior, not attacker-reachable.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Invariant holds: every remotely-received gossip sidecar must pass inclusion proof verification before being accepted. VerifiedRODataColumn type gate via allSatisfied() check enforces this.

audit_items.rationale: Property correctly implemented. RequireSidecarInclusionProven is in GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements (data_column.go:36), the check is called at validate_data_column.go:143, and it returns REJECT on any failure.

audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Does actor-p2p-peer relay only data column sidecars with valid inclusion proofs?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Gossip acceptance sets msg.ValidatorData only after full verification including SidecarInclusionProven. Only messages where msg.ValidatorData is set to a VerifiedRODataColumn are propagated by libp2p PubSub. VerifiedRODataColumn is obtainable only via VerifiedRODataColumns() which requires allSatisfied().

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample. VerifiedRODataColumn newtype is only obtainable after allSatisfied() passes, enforcing inclusion proof verification before relay.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Relay path requires ValidationAccept which requires SidecarInclusionProven to pass.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Peers relay only sidecars that have passed the full verification pipeline including inclusion proof. Type-system enforcement via VerifiedRODataColumn gate.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: VerifiedRODataColumn type gate via VerifiedRODataColumns() allSatisfied() check

audit_items.rationale: Property correctly implemented; relay is contingent on full validation including inclusion proof.

audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Does actor-beacon-node reject sidecars with invalid inclusion proofs from any source?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Three intake paths verified: (1) Gossip: GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements includes RequireSidecarInclusionProven, enforced at validate_data_column.go:143. (2) RPC by-root: ByRootRequestDataColumnSidecarRequirements includes RequireSidecarInclusionProven. (3) RPC by-range: ByRangeRequestDataColumnSidecarRequirements includes RequireSidecarInclusionProven. All paths enforce it.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample. All three intake paths enforce inclusion proof verification. Local storage only saves VerifiedRODataColumn which requires proof verification at original storage time.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: All external intake paths checked; RequireSidecarInclusionProven in all three requirement sets.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Beacon node rejects sidecars with invalid inclusion proofs from all external sources (gossip and both RPC variants). Type gate prevents storage of unverified sidecars.

audit_items.rationale: Property correctly implemented across all intake paths (gossip + RPC by-root + RPC by-range).

audit_items.title: Falsification Test: Can a sidecar with an invalid inclusion proof be accepted by the gossip validation pipeline?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: The only ValidationAccept path that bypasses SidecarInclusionProven is the own-peer check (pid == s.cfg.p2p.PeerID()), which only applies to local node messages. All remote peer paths must pass SidecarInclusionProven.
state_anomalies_found: Own-peer bypass at validate_data_column.go:37-39 skips all verification for self-originated messages — by design, not exploitable by remote attackers

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Exhaustive path analysis: remote attacker cannot set pid == local peer ID; all remote gossip paths require SidecarInclusionProven to pass for ValidationAccept; ValidationIgnore paths do not accept or propagate the sidecar.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: No attacker-reachable path exists to have a sidecar with invalid inclusion proof accepted by gossip validation.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Falsification claim is false; inclusion proof enforcement invariant holds for all remotely-sourced gossip messages.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: verifier.SidecarInclusionProven() at validate_data_column.go:143 is mandatory for all non-self gossip messages

audit_items.rationale: No vulnerability. Property holds; no bypass exists for attacker-controlled inputs. Own-peer bypass is standard libp2p design behavior and is not attacker-reachable.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Is verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs called for every data column sidecar in the gossip validation pipeline?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: KZG verification called via two paths: (1) gossip: validateWithKzgBatchVerifier enqueues to kzgChan and either gets batch result or falls back to validateUnbatchedColumnsKzg (both enforce KZG); (2) RPC: verifyByRootDataColumnSidecars calls SidecarKzgProofVerified(). RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified is in all three requirement lists (GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements, ByRangeRequestDataColumnSidecarRequirements, ByRootRequestDataColumnSidecarRequirements).

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Context-timeout path in validateWithKzgBatchVerifier returns ValidationIgnore (not ValidationAccept), so no sidecar is falsely accepted on timeout. No bypass path found.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Only bypass is kzgChan context timeout which returns ValidationIgnore — message dropped, not accepted.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Invariant holds: VerifiedRODataColumns() enforces allSatisfied() which checks RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified. Without KZG verification passing, VerifiedRODataColumn type upgrade cannot occur.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: results.allSatisfied() check in VerifiedRODataColumns() + RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified in all requirement lists

audit_items.rationale: KZG verification is called unconditionally on all paths. Property holds.

audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Does actor-p2p-peer enforce KZG proof verification before relaying data column sidecars?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: In validateDataColumn, KZG verification via validateWithKzgBatchVerifier is step 11 of 12. Only a sidecar that returns ValidationAccept has RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified satisfied and proceeds. msg.ValidatorData is only set to a VerifiedRODataColumn on successful completion.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Sidecar with invalid KZG proofs: batch fails -> validateUnbatchedColumnsKzg fallback -> ValidationReject. No path to relay unverified sidecars.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Peer sending invalid sidecar receives ValidationReject after KZG failure; sidecar is not propagated.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: KZG verification enforced before msg.ValidatorData is set; libp2p only relays ValidationAccept messages; invalid KZG returns ValidationReject through fallback.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: validateWithKzgBatchVerifier + validateUnbatchedColumnsKzg fallback, both preceding msg.ValidatorData assignment

audit_items.rationale: KZG verification is enforced before relay; no path allows an invalid sidecar to be propagated.

audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Does actor-beacon-node reject sidecars with invalid KZG proofs from any source?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Three ingestion paths: (1) Gossip: validateWithKzgBatchVerifier + fallback; (2) ByRoot RPC: SidecarKzgProofVerified() -> VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs; (3) ByRange RPC: same requirements list. All include RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified. Storage path (dataColumnStorage.Save()) only accepts VerifiedRODataColumn slices.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample. All storage paths go through VerifiedRODataColumn type, requiring KZG to be satisfied.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Storage write path requires VerifiedRODataColumn which is type-gated behind KZG verification.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Type system enforces invariant: only VerifiedRODataColumn (requires RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified) can be passed to dataColumnStorage.Save().
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: VerifiedRODataColumn type gate + RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified in all requirement lists

audit_items.rationale: All ingestion paths enforce KZG rejection before any storage write. No path stores sidecars with invalid KZG proofs.

audit_items.title: Falsification Test: Can a sidecar with tampered column data and invalid KZG proofs be accepted by the gossip validation pipeline?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs builds (commitments[i], sidecar.Index, Column[i], KzgProofs[i]) tuples and passes full batch to ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch. Mismatched Column data causes pairing check to fail returning (false, nil) -> ErrInvalidKZGProof. Note on batch verifier: when multiple gossip sidecars batched, all get same error if batch fails; each independently retries via validateUnbatchedColumnsKzg. Invalid sidecar correctly rejected, valid sibling correctly accepted — no cross-contamination.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Tampered Column[i] with valid structural fields: VerifyCellKZGProofBatch returns false -> ErrInvalidKZGProof -> validateUnbatchedColumnsKzg -> ValidationReject. No accepting path found.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Attacker controls Column data and KzgProofs; however verification mathematically binds cells to commitments via KZG multi-proof, which is cryptographically binding.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Cryptographic binding: VerifyCellKZGProofBatch is pairing-based; forgery requires breaking KZG commitment scheme. Code-level: tampered data -> pairing check fails -> ErrInvalidKZGProof -> ValidationReject in all paths.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch + ErrInvalidKZGProof error propagation + ValidationReject return

audit_items.rationale: Falsification attempt fails: tampered sidecars are cryptographically rejected by C-KZG library and rejected at network layer. Forgery would require breaking KZG commitment scheme.

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition Ordering: Does KZG proof verification occur after structural and signature validation?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Ordering in validateDataColumn confirmed: ValidFields(1) -> CorrectSubnet(2) -> NotFromFutureSlot(3) -> SlotAboveFinalized(4) -> SidecarParentSeen(5) -> SidecarParentValid(6) -> ValidProposerSignature(7) -> SidecarParentSlotLower(8) -> SidecarDescendsFromFinalized(9) -> SidecarInclusionProven(10) -> validateWithKzgBatchVerifier/KZG(11) -> SidecarProposerExpected(12). KZG is step 11.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample: no early path skips to KZG without structural checks. Each check returns error on failure causing early return before KZG.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Ordering enforced by sequential code flow in validateDataColumn; comment notes documented deviation (ValidProposerSignature moved earlier for practical reasons, still before KZG).

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Ordering invariant confirmed: structural checks (1-4), parent/finality (5-9), inclusion proof (10) all occur before KZG (11). Matches spec ordering.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: Sequential function call ordering in validateDataColumn; no conditional bypass of early steps

audit_items.rationale: KZG verification correctly occurs at step 11, after all structural (steps 1-9), signature (step 7), and inclusion-proof (step 10) validations. Ordering matches spec.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001/tb-002/tb-003: Does bytes_to_bls_field reject integers >= BLS_MODULUS?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: VerifyCellKZGProofBatch (kzg.go:98-106) delegates entirely to ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch. Inside C-KZG library, verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch calls compute_commitment_to_aggregated_interpolation_poly which calls bytes_to_bls_field for each field element. bytes_to_bls_field (bytes.c:64-70) calls blst_scalar_fr_check which calls check_mod_256(a, BLS12_381_r) — a hard rejection (C_KZG_BADARGS) if value >= BLS_MODULUS. NOT a silent modular reduction.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample. Any cell with out-of-range field element causes C_KZG_BADARGS -> propagates through Go call chain -> ValidationReject at P2P layer.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Range check is at C-KZG library level, not in Go code. Both P2P gossip and EL-delivered blob paths ultimately invoke C-KZG which enforces this check.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Check is present, enforced as hard error (C_KZG_BADARGS, not modular reduction), and propagates correctly. blst_scalar_fr_check in supranational/blst correctly compares against BLS12_381_r (= BLS_MODULUS).
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: bytes_to_bls_field -> blst_scalar_fr_check -> check_mod_256(a, BLS12_381_r) in C-KZG library

audit_items.rationale: bytes_to_bls_field range check is correctly implemented in C-KZG library as a hard rejection (C_KZG_BADARGS) via blst_scalar_fr_check. Not a silent modular reduction. Check is present and correctly enforced.

audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Is range validation enforced when actor-blob-submitter sends type-3 transactions with blob data?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: CL does not directly deserialize blob field elements from mempool. Flow: EL mempool -> EL validates type-3 transactions (primary gatekeeper) -> Engine API (BlobsBundleV2) -> CL calls ComputeCells -> ckzg4844.ComputeCells -> blob_to_polynomial -> bytes_to_bls_field for all 4096 field elements per blob. Same bytes_to_bls_field range check applies. If any field element >= BLS_MODULUS, C_KZG_BADARGS propagates and CL-side verification fails.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample. EL is primary gatekeeper; C-KZG provides defense-in-depth at CL level.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Type-3 transaction blob bytes are gated at EL mempool (primary) and C-KZG inside CL (secondary). Double enforcement.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Range validation enforced via defense-in-depth: EL as primary, C-KZG bytes_to_bls_field at CL level as secondary.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: EL mempool validation (primary) + bytes_to_bls_field in C-KZG during CL ComputeCells (secondary)

audit_items.rationale: Range validation is enforced at both EL (primary) and CL via C-KZG library (secondary). Property holds with defense-in-depth.

audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Is range validation enforced when actor-p2p-peer receives cells via gossip or RPC?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: P2P gossip path: (1) DataColumnSidecar received; (2) VerifyDataColumnSidecar structural checks (does NOT check field element ranges); (3) VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs -> kzg.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch -> ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch -> C library verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch; (4) C library calls bytes_to_bls_field for all 64 field elements of each received cell; (5) field element >= BLS_MODULUS: C_KZG_BADARGS -> propagates -> ValidationReject.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample. Crafted cell with out-of-range field element triggers C_KZG_BADARGS in C-KZG -> Go error propagation -> ValidationReject. Peer scoring penalizes sender.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Range check is implicit via C-KZG KZG verification step; consistently enforced for both gossip and RPC paths.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Range validation is enforced implicitly during KZG verification via C-KZG bytes_to_bls_field for P2P-received cells. ValidationReject correctly penalizes sender.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: bytes_to_bls_field in C-KZG library called during VerifyCellKZGProofBatch for each received cell's 64 field elements

audit_items.rationale: Range validation enforced implicitly via C-KZG library during KZG proof verification for all P2P-received cells. Out-of-range field elements cause C_KZG_BADARGS and ValidationReject with peer penalization.
